title: Preserve F# workspace-reference completeness across evaluated project-reference paths
outcome: Workspace-dependent F# references discover property-expanded source ProjectReference consumers or disclose an explicit lower bound when evaluated graph authority is incomplete.
acceptance: A public references regression using $(DependencyDir)/Library.fsproj includes the consumer without false workspaceComplete, or explicitly reports the omitted scope as a lower bound.

completion.summary: Evaluated ProjectReference authority now augments persisted F# reverse edges from one pinned snapshot and fails honestly to unknown/lower-bound coverage.
